summary: Fifteen regular-season games were played on Monday, and one went to overtime. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored a night-high 43 points in Oklahoma City's 117-112 win over Cleveland, and Ty Jerome scored 40 in Memphis' 135-134 overtime loss to New Orleans. Detroit had the largest margin, beating Charlotte 124-91.

games.headline: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 43 as Thunder top Cavaliers
games.story: Oklahoma City led by as many as 14 and was up 59-48 at halftime. Cleveland won the third quarter 36-31 to cut it to 90-84, and the game was tied at 112 with 1:01 left in the fourth. The Thunder scored the last five points to win 117-112. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 43 on 14-of-35 shooting, including 11 of 12 at the line, while Oklahoma City was without Chet Holmgren and Jalen Williams.

games.headline: Maxey, Brown lead 76ers past Bulls 126-107
games.story: Chicago scored 36 in the second quarter, and the game was tied at 50 with 3:50 left in the half. Philadelphia led 64-59 at halftime, was ahead 90-79 after three and pushed its lead to 22. Tyrese Maxey scored 26 with 11 assists, Jaylen Brown added 25 with 11 rebounds, and VJ Edgecombe had 21. Caleb Wilson led Chicago with 24, and the Bulls were without Nic Claxton.

games.headline: Alexander-Walker scores 34 as Hawks hold off Pacers
games.story: Atlanta scored 37 in the first quarter, went ahead for good after a 20-20 tie, and led 68-56 at halftime. The Hawks' lead reached 15, and they were up 87-79 after three. Indiana won the fourth quarter 25-21 but lost 108-104. Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 34 with nine threes, and Jay Huff had 22 points and 8 rebounds for the Pacers, who were without Tyrese Haliburton.

games.headline: Knicks outscore Nets 28-11 in the fourth to win 103-90
games.story: New York led 51-44 at halftime, but Brooklyn won the third quarter 35-24 and led 79-75 going into the fourth. The Nets still led 79-78 with 10:49 left, and the Knicks were ahead for good after that, winning the period 28-11. Landry Shamet scored 22 on 6-of-8 shooting, Jalen Brunson added 19 and OG Anunoby 18. Julius Randle had 21 points and 11 rebounds for Brooklyn.

games.headline: Wizards beat Magic 103-94 as Orlando scores 9 in the third
games.story: Orlando led 33-28 after one quarter, and Washington was up 60-59 at halftime. The Magic scored only nine points in the third quarter, and the Wizards led 79-68 going into the fourth. Anthony Davis scored 27 on 12-of-17 shooting, Kyshawn George had 22 and AJ Dybantsa 21. Franz Wagner scored 24 for Orlando, which was without Paolo Banchero and Jalen Suggs.

games.headline: Cunningham scores 33 as Pistons rout Hornets 124-91
games.story: The game was tied at 37 with 7:01 left in the second quarter, and Detroit led 65-54 at halftime. The Pistons outscored Charlotte 33-21 in the third to go up 98-75 and later led by 33. Cade Cunningham scored 33 on 13-of-20 shooting, and Duncan Robinson made six threes for 24. Brandon Miller led Charlotte with 17, and the Hornets were without Kon Knueppel.

games.headline: Kings pull away from Mavericks in second half, 115-100
games.story: Sacramento led 54-53 at halftime, and Dallas went ahead 65-64 with 6:03 left in the third quarter. The Kings were ahead for good after that and outscored the Mavericks 61-47 in the second half, building a lead of as many as 19. Darius Acuff Jr. scored 25, Malik Monk 24 and Zach LaVine 23. Dallas, without Kyrie Irving, got 20 each from Daniel Gafford and Walter Clayton Jr.

games.headline: Ball scores 34 as Timberwolves beat Bucks 112-100
games.story: Minnesota scored 29 in the first quarter, but Milwaukee won the second 29-19 to trail only 48-47 at halftime. The game was tied at 69 with 3:00 left in the third, and the Timberwolves won the fourth quarter 32-24, building a lead of as many as 15. LaMelo Ball scored 34, and Ayo Dosunmu had 19 points, 12 rebounds and 8 assists. Minnesota was without Anthony Edwards; Tyler Herro led Milwaukee with 21.

games.headline: Pelicans edge Grizzlies 135-134 in overtime
games.story: New Orleans led 100-95 after three, but Memphis scored the last nine points of regulation, from 9 down with 2:36 left, to tie it at 124. The game was tied again at 134 with 7 seconds left in overtime, and the Pelicans made two free throws to win 135-134. Ty Jerome scored 40 for Memphis on 14-of-22 shooting. Zion Williamson and Karlo Matković each scored 25 for New Orleans.

games.headline: Rockets beat Celtics 109-93; Boston never leads
games.story: Boston never led. The game was tied at 29 after one quarter, Houston led 57-50 at halftime and 82-73 after three, and the lead reached 18. Alperen Sengun scored 26 on 12-of-15 shooting with 10 assists, and Jabari Smith Jr. had 14 points and 10 rebounds. Jayson Tatum scored 19 and made all eight of his free throws, and the Celtics were without Paul George.

games.headline: Spurs outscore Jazz 35-20 in third, win 119-97
games.story: San Antonio was ahead for good after a 2-2 tie in the first quarter and led 59-49 at halftime. The Spurs won the third quarter 35-20 to go up 94-69, and their lead reached 26. Dylan Harper had 17 points, 8 assists and 7 rebounds, and Stephon Castle added 16. Lauri Markkanen led Utah with 22, and the Jazz were without Jaren Jackson Jr.

games.headline: Trail Blazers rally past Nuggets 118-110
games.story: Denver led by as many as 14 early in the second quarter and was ahead 66-58 at halftime. Portland scored 39 in the second quarter, still trailed 87-85 after three, and tied the game at 89 with 10:23 left. The Trail Blazers won the fourth quarter 33-23. Deni Avdija scored 28 and Donovan Clingan had 17 points and 18 rebounds, while Jamal Murray scored 35 and Nikola Jokić had 26 points for Denver.

games.headline: Raptors score 47 in the fourth to beat Clippers 125-118
games.story: Los Angeles led by as many as 16 in the third quarter and was ahead 91-78 after three. Toronto outscored the Clippers 47-27 in the fourth and tied the game at 109 with 2:44 left. The Raptors were ahead for good after that. Immanuel Quickley scored 27, RJ Barrett 26 and Scottie Barnes had 22 points and 15 rebounds, while Kobe Sanders led Los Angeles with 26.

games.headline: Warriors rally from 17 down to beat Suns 116-113
games.story: Phoenix led by 17 in the second quarter and was ahead 57-51 at halftime. Golden State scored 42 in the third quarter to tie the game at 93, and it was tied again at 106 with 4:39 left. The Warriors outscored the Suns 10-7 the rest of the way. Stephen Curry scored 34, going 11 of 12 at the line, and Devin Booker had 26 for Phoenix.

games.headline: Dončić scores 42 as Lakers beat Heat 138-117
games.story: Both teams scored 42 in the second quarter, and the game was tied at 52 with 6:06 left in the half. Los Angeles led 79-72 at halftime, won the third quarter 32-21 to go up 111-93, and led by as many as 24. Luka Dončić scored 42 with 13 assists and Austin Reaves added 27. Giannis Antetokounmpo had 30 points and 12 rebounds for Miami.
